title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Queching the flames of war demands prolonged suffering. To ignite them, however, it takes naught but a lapse of thought.

title: Talk 1
original: The fall of Chernobog dealt a devastating blow to Azazel, our clinic. I must rebuild it for the children. As long as they can have a shelter to call home, any place will do. You don't need a reason to try for your family.

title: Talk 2
original: Rhodes Island is in a respectable position, but the Infected of Ursus face prospects far worse than anyone could imagine. They must be ready to resort to violence in order to survive. At the end of the day, virtue and dignity hold meaning only for those who live to see the next dawn.

title: Talk 3
original: All Ursus should take pride in their nation and their Emperor.' I, too, fought for Ursus once, but I don't have the passion driving me anymore. Time has robbed me of too much.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: Life in the military has taught me two things: First, have faith in your fellow soldiers; second, have faith in them, but do not trust them. This dilemma has always plagued our lands, and none can escape it.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: Dr. {@nickname}, a limitless future awaits you, just as it does for those children. Though I can neither let go of yesterday nor look forward to tomorrow, I shall fight for you till my last drop of blood, so you may be part of that future.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: I am fine with Ursus as my enemy. Once I swore my utmost loyalty to it, but that was returned with endless disillusionment and shame. For the children's sake, I will never falter, much less surrender.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: Once there was a long battle. When I finally broke into the enemy headquarters, I was too late... All I could do for my dying friend was take his pocket watch and sword. The enemy lost their commander, whose death brought us a brief victory. That day, Ursus enjoyed her momentary triumph, but I knew my war was over. A war where I lost everything.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: The photograph inside my pocket watch? Hahahah, so you saw it... This is Neon from when she was little. Isn't she adorable? She's not so quiet anymore, but she loves herself now, and that's all that matters... Live free, Dr. {@nickname}, that's my wish, even if it is trite.

title: Idle
original: Don't lose focus. You must be alert at all times on Rhodes Island.

title: Onboard
original: Hellagur, an infected mercenary. I will work with Rhodes Island in order to rebuild my Azazel Clinic and protect my family. But be advised, I have no medical skills.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: Battlefields may change, but not the cruelty.

title: Promotion 1
original: I'm used to it as a soldier, but I find it fascinating as an infected. Thank you for the ribbon, Dr. {@nickname}.

title: Promotion 2
original: War will never truly be over, but I believe even this land will end eventually. Maybe you can end our suffering one day, Dr. {@nickname}. Now, give me your order!

title: Added to Squad
original: Only butchers thirst for blood. We are merely paying the price of survival.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: I'll have them following orders to Ursus army standards!

title: Depart
original: I don't mind losing my life, if that is enough to end this all.

title: Begin Operation
original: You have never seen a real war, pathetic runts.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: I was born to fight.

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: A slip of the mind is the difference between life and death.

title: Deployment 1
original: Killing is but the last resort.

title: Deployment 2
original: I've never truly left the battlefield, I know.

title: In Battle 1
original: A lash of blade, the flesh to flay.

title: In Battle 2
original: A thrust of whip, the sword to rip.

title: In Battle 3
original: A cleave of spear, the armor to tear!

title: In Battle 4
original: Decapitator'… Our sacrifices were not in vain.

title: 4-star Result
original: You leave the fight behind, and pay for it with yet more fighting.

title: 3-star Result
original: Avert your eyes, I'm about to end their misery.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: Keep your guard up. One flaw is all the enemy needs to turn the tables.

title: Operation Failure
original: There is no shame in failure. At least you had the chance to learn from it.

title: Assigned to Facility
original: If only I can find shelter for the children.

title: Tap
original: Hmm?

title: Trust Tap
original: Would you like a candy? I still have some. But watch out for cavities.

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: It escapes me how many New Years I've spent in trenches, or under the blaze of artillery. War is no stickler for timekeeping, and the greater part of my life has been embroiled in it. This holiday won't turn new pages for me anymore. That being said, don't the children look happy? Hah.

title: Greeting
original: You look well, Doctor.

title: Birthday
original: As every child has a birthday, it gives me hope that maturity will come to them. Age will overtake me, like it or not, and I can only hope they'll still live safely after I am gone. You're still growing too, Doctor. Happy birthday.

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: I must express my gratitude to Rhodes Island. The longer the war stretches on, the more I realize the importance of a place to rest. Has the technology Azazel brought to Rhodes Island been of help...? That is good. After all, I can do little else but wield my blade in your service.
